recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If future work groups want to clarify how required new parameters interact with later compatibility guidance, that should be handled as a new derivation-guidance issue rather than by replaying FHIR-30509.
issue_request: FHIR-30509 is Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked that an OperationDefinition derived from a base OperationDefinition be allowed to introduce new parameters in addition to base parameters. The accepted wording says a constrained profile can make optional parameters required or not used, introduce new parameters (required or optional), and clarify documentation.
initial_application: Commit ecd177722cbd27b6abf4e8610489a0ea592ca0a7 applied the issue by changing the OperationDefinition.base comment in source/operationdefinition/structuredefinition-OperationDefinition.xml to include the accepted new-parameters wording.
additional_context: Later FHIR-38034 moved the derived OperationDefinition guidance out of the OperationDefinition.base comment and into source/operationdefinition/operationdefinition-notes.xml; that related issue is already represented on the combined branch. Later FHIR-48481, also represented, added detailed SHOULD-level derivation rules and optional-parameter compatibility guidance without removing the explicit allowance for new required or optional parameters. FHIR-52921 later added parameter/profile alignment guidance in the same notes file but does not change the seed decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build-scope OperationDefinition notes already preserve the seed rule, and restoring the old OperationDefinition.base comment would duplicate or undo later accepted refactoring.

related_jiras.note: Moved the OperationDefinition.base guidance into the Derived OperationDefinitions notes section and is already represented on the combined branch.

Added detailed SHOULD-level OperationDefinition derivation rules and version-specific base-reference guidance; it is already represented on the combined branch and constrains why this audit should not edit the base element comment.
Later parameter/profile alignment guidance touches the same notes file but addresses profile alignment, not the seed's base-parameter allowance.
